package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "net/http"
    "net/http/httptest"
    "os"
    "reflect"
    "strings"
    "testing"
    "time"
)

// This adapter records real refresh side effects, not a test-runner pass flag.
func TestFrozenAgentRefreshObservation(t *testing.T) {
    m := newTestManager(t)
    server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
        http.Error(w, `{"error":"unavailable","message":"try later"}`, http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
    }))
    defer server.Close()
    m.remote = &remoteRegistry{baseURL: server.URL, cachePath: m.paths.remoteRegistry, client: server.Client()}
    logger, logs := testLogger()
    err := runRefreshRunner(t.Context(), m, logger)
    // The storage field was renamed between the two pinned snapshots.
    p := reflect.ValueOf(m.paths).FieldByName("refreshCompleted")
    if !p.IsValid() { p = reflect.ValueOf(m.paths).FieldByName("refreshSuccess") }
    observed := map[string]any{
        "runner_error": err != nil,
        "registry_failure_logged": strings.Contains(logs.String(), "registry cache refresh failed"),
        "retry_due": refreshSpawnDue(p.String(), time.Now()),
        "retry_due_after_interval": refreshSpawnDue(p.String(), time.Now().Add(remoteRefreshInterval)),
    }
    data, err := json.Marshal(observed)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("FROZEN_REFRESH_RESULT"), data, 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
